title: H 3822 (124th General Assembly): Voting
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Sec. 8 (7-13-710(A))
(quote) (5) South Carolina voter registration card containing a photograph of the voter pursuant to Section 7-5-675; or (6) a college or university identification card containing a photograph.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) Sec. 1 (new 7-5-145(B)(2))
(quote) provide proof of residence by presenting any of the following valid documents that show the person's current name and current residence address: a South Carolina drivers license, another form of identification containing a photograph issued by the South Carolina Department of Motor Vehicles, or any of the documents listed in Section 7-13-710.
(section) Sec. 4 (new 7-15-425(B))
(quote) The voter may cure the deficiency or deficiencies identified by the county board by filing a duly signed affirmation attesting to the same information required by the return-addressed envelope and attesting that the signer of the oath is the same person who submitted such absentee ballot return-addressed envelope.
(other) Sec. 1 (new 7-5-145): same-day in-person registration and voting at an in-person absentee location, with proof of residence; county and State Election Commission verify the ID within two business days.
(other) Sec. 2 (new 7-13-200): elections by mail or secure drop box; ballot mailed to each active elector 14-20 days before the election; signature on return envelope checked against registration record.
(other) Sec. 3 (new 7-15-325): no-excuse absentee voting and a thirty-day in-person absentee period.
(other) Sec. 4 (new 7-15-425): cure process for unsigned or mismatched-signature absentee envelopes (affirmation within seven business days).
(other) Sec. 5 (new 7-15-427): absentee ballot counts if postmarked by election day and delivered by close of business on the last business day before county canvass.
(other) Sec. 6-7 (new 24-3-185, 24-3-980): corrections and probation agencies must tell released felons about restoration of voting rights and registration eligibility.
(other) Sec. 9, 11-13: remove the witness requirement from the absentee oath (7-15-220, 7-15-380, 7-15-385, 7-15-420).
(other) Sec. 10 (7-15-340): removes references to the reason for requesting an absentee ballot.
(other) Sec. 14: repeals 7-15-320 (list of who may vote absentee).
(other) version: Only one version (Introduced, 2021-02-04). Slot a: adds college or university photo ID card to the 7-13-710(A) list; other items reprinted unchanged. No change to the no-ID remedy (7-13-710(D) not reprinted). No mail-ballot ID, no citizenship proof.
(other) note: Only the introduced text is saved. 7-13-710(A) is reprinted with the struck 'or' words only; the five existing ID items are unchanged. The same-day registration proof-of-residence rule (7-5-145) is listed under slot e.
